song.cwHasNoJustification: You must add a reason for wanting to add a content warning onto the page, e.g. violent content, sexual content, etc.
song.genAiHasNoUsageAttribution: You must specify which part of the song/video uses Generative AI, e.g. illustration, lyrics.
song.genAiHasNoSource: You must add a source/explanation attributing to the verified/suspected usage of Generative AI.
song.noTitle: You haven't entered a song title.
song.noDate: You haven't entered the date of publication.
song.noSingerInMarkup: You need to list at least one singer in markup, e.g. [[Kagamine Rin]].
song.noProducer: You haven't listed any producers. For well-known producers, it is recommended that the producer's name is listed in markup, e.g. [[wowaka]], before you generate the song page.
song.noProducerInMarkup: If the producer already has a page on VOCALOID Lyrics wiki, then you should add the name of that producer in markup, e.g. "[[wowaka]] (music)" or "[[nagimiso]] (illustration)". Clicking the "Autoload Categories" button again in this case will automatically generate the category for that producer.
song.noPlayLink: No music videos or play links are detected. Please check the "Song is publically unavailable" if official releases are no longer available, or check the "Song is an album-only release" option if the song is released on albums only
song.noViewCount: Did you forget to add the view counts?
song.bilibiliUsesAvid: The Vocaloid Lyrics Wiki recommends attaching Bilibili links in the new BVid format rather than the old avid format.
song.uncreditedTranslation: A translation exists, but the translator is uncredited. Is it made by an anonymous contributor?

album.albumTitleNotSet: You haven't entered an album name.
album.descriptionNotSet: You must add a short description about the album.
album.pubDateNotSet: You must add an album publication date.
album.pubYearNotSet: You must specify the album publication year.
album.pubMonthNotSet: You must specify the album publication month.
album.noVocaDbLink: It is recommended to add a link to the VocaDB album page if it exists.
album.noTrackListed: You must add at least one song to the tracklist.
album.noTracklistNumbering: You must add the track listing number to all tracks.
album.discNumberIsNotNumeric: The disc number must be numeric.
album.trackNumberIsNotNumeric: The track number must be numeric.
album.emptyTrackName: You must add a track name to all tracks.
album.emptyTrackCredits: You must add featured producers/singers to all tracks, or specify that the song is an instrumental if there are no singers.
album.officialLinkNotListed: You should add at least one album crossfade or streaming (Spotify, YouTube Music, Bandcamp) link.
album.synthEngineNotListed: Please list at least one vocal synth engine, e.g. VOCALOID. Choose "Other/Unlisted" if not on the list.
album.noCategories: Did you forget to add categories?
album.invalidEmbedCode: An invalid embed URL is supplied for the following services: {1}

producer.noProdCat: You must add the producer category page name for the producer. (This will be used as the parameter of {{ProdLinks}})
producer.prodRoleNotSelected: You must specify at least one role for the producer, e.g. Do they compose their own songs? Are they an illustrator/PV maker for other producers?
producer.descriptionNotSet: You must add a description for the producer. Even a short description, e.g. "[PRODUCER] is a VOCALOID producer.", will do.
producer.extLinkNotListed: You must add at least one external link.
producer.extLinkNotOfficial: You must add at least one official external link, e.g. the producer's social media.
producer.noSongPage: No song page has been added.
